label: D2 after staying with a1 following a rare-unrewarded a1 trial (before late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when this trial chose a1 and the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew 0 at the preceding D1). Nearly all of it (>99% recall) comes when the previous trial was also a1 with a rare transition to S2 (or the previous trial lies outside the window), i.e. the model-based stay pattern a1-rare-unrewarded -> repeat a1. It is silent on D1/GO, after any a2 choice, after rewarded trials, and after common-unrewarded a1 trials. It also fades out late in the episode (almost no activity at ep_trial >= 80, none at >= 90); adding ep_trial < 80 lifts dev F1 from 0.71 to 0.80. All variables are observed at D2. Magnitude: in the top windows it is about 1.0 when the reached state is S1 (common) and about 0.5 when it is S2 (rare); S1 holds 86% of the activation mass. This comes from the example windows and the mass table, and was not checked any further. Precision is still about 0.67: many steps that match the pattern stay silent, depending on the longer reward history in ways I could not capture. That is why the verdict is partially_explained.
